title: WCLAP Rack document
description: A wclap-rack v1 document: an ordered serial chain of WCLAP audio-effect devices, each referencing a bundle by MANIFEST key. See SPEC.md.

bundle.description: MANIFEST key of the WCLAP bundle

plugin.description: clap plugin id inside the bundle

params.description: clap param id (string) or name -> raw CLAP value within [min, max]; applied at frame 0 of the device's render

state.description: base64 clap.state blob, loaded before params
